literal.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?

literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax identifies Broca’s area with language production and speech movements (L54), the cerebellum with balance-related sensory comparison (L120), face-selective cortex in the posterior fusiform gyrus (PMC abstract L112), and primary visual perception in occipital areas 17/18 (OpenStax L48). These passages support the unique key and establish that each distractor is a real brain function, while only speech production answers the Broca-area prompt.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax L48, L54, L120; PMC L112-L114

literalGroups.literal: Область Брока связана с продукцией языка и контролем движений, необходимых для речи. У большинства людей она расположена в левом полушарии.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax states that Broca’s area is responsible for language production or controlling movements responsible for speech (L54), and says the area is located on the left in the vast majority of people (L54). It also cautions that language is distributed and not monopolized by one hemisphere (L79-L82); the revised wording therefore says “у большинства людей”.

literalGroups.literal: Мозжечок сравнивает двигательные команды с обратной связью от мышц и суставов, включая ощущения равновесия.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax describes the cerebellum comparing descending motor commands with sensory feedback, including proprioception and sensations of balance, then sending corrective commands (L119-L121). The revised note states that concrete relationship rather than borrowing the old SOURCE10 cerebellum sentence.

literalGroups.literal: В задней части веретенообразной извилины есть участок коры, избирательно реагирующий на лица.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The fMRI study reports a face-selective cortical area in the posterior fusiform gyrus (abstract L112) and identifies the human fusiform face area as part of the ventral visual form-processing stream (L114). The revised note is limited to the directly supported location and response.

literalGroups.literal: Область Брока связана с контролем движений, необходимых для речи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax directly associates Broca’s area with language production and control of speech movements (L54). The note adds the movement-control detail beyond the option “Продуцированием речи”.

literalGroups.literal: Затылочные области 17 и 18 отвечают за первичное зрительное восприятие; зрительная информация обрабатывается и в височной и теменной долях.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax identifies occipital Brodmann areas 17 and 18 with primary visual perception and notes further visual-information processing in temporal and parietal lobes (L48). The answer and note were broadened from the unsupported color-specific claim to that directly sourced visual function.
